title: Isigulane
intro: Kudala, ngemihla yokuqala yembali yoluntu, imiphefumlo emibini yayimi phambi koMdali wayo ineminikelo. Omnye wamkelwe, omnye akamkelwa. Okwalandela emva koko kwaba yintlekele yokuqala enkulu phakathi kwabazalwana noodade - isenzo esinye sokuzibamba ngomonde kunye nesenzo esinye sokuziphindezela okukrakra. Ungandityhila ukuba ndingubani?
clues: Ndazalwa kwiintsuku zokuqala zobomi bomntu emhlabeni
Ndandingumntwana wabantu bokuqala ukuhamba apha emhlabeni
Ndakha ndanikela umbingelelo kwimfuyo yam eyona ilungileyo ukuze ndikholise uMdali wam
Umnikelo wam wamkelwa phezulu, ngoxa umnikelo womntakwethu walahlwa
Xa ndandisongelwa ngokufa, ndakhetha ukungaphakamisi isandla sam nxamnye nomntakwabo
Ndaba ngumntu wokuqala kwimbali yoluntu ukubulawa ngomnye umntu ngokungekho mthethweni

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Waba lixhoba lokuqala lokubulawa kwimbali yoluntu
Wasinda kwisikhukula esikhulu ngaphakathi kwinqanawa eyenziwe ngomthi
Wazulazula iminyaka engamashumi amane entlango enkulu
outcome.answer: Waba lixhoba lokuqala lokubulawa kwimbali yoluntu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
